findings.text: The smart seat is never told the Prompt's id. `Servex/agents/Sessions.js:443` mints `p-<ms>` and writes it, but the text sent to the fast seat leaves the id out, and so do the smart seat's waker copy and `send()`. `session-smart.md:64-68` then has it write `{"p-<ms>": …}` against an id it cannot know, so replies, questions and refinements will land on a key that doesn't exist. Return the id from `voice_say`, keep it on `s`, and put it in the smart seat's message (e.g. `(prompt p-123)`).

Each fallback respawn makes a second Prompt for the same words. `Sessions.js:385` re-sends `last_owner` through `voice_say`, and that now calls `add_prompt` with a new id (`Sessions.js:443`), which breaks the brief's "never make a second Prompt for one utterance". Write the Prompt in `say()`/`release_thought()` instead, or skip the write on the recovery path.

The owner's timing isn't met: "A new Prompt is added when the owner starts speaking. Each utterance pushes its raw Whisper text." The Prompt is written only when a held thought is released, after the pause (`release_thought` → `voice_say`), and it arrives with all its raw words at once. `push_raw` and `add_paragraph`/`append_paragraph` are never called from Sessions.js, so live speech never reaches Chat v2 while the owner talks. Add the Prompt on the first line of `hold_thought` and `push_raw` on each `say()`.

No Prompt is written at all unless `voice_seat()` is true (`Sessions.js:407`, `assistant === "voice"`). Sessions on the other seat (`send(s,"fast",…)`, `Sessions.js:926`, `:1060`) get no chat, and neither plan.md nor the readme says so. Either write the Prompt in `say()` whatever the seat, or state the limit in the readme's "Who writes the data".

`report.js:6` posts to a relative `/api/voice`. On the site (monorepo.localhost) that goes to the dev server, not Servex. Every other caller uses `servex_url("/api/voice")` (`ext/Refine/RefineSystem.js:103`, helper `public/framework/dev/servex_url.js:17`), so as written, errors and clicks never arrive.

Nothing went into the readme's Decisions (`public/framework/ext/Chat/v2/readme.md:33`), though the brief asks for each decision there with its alternative. Missing are: one Prompt per `voice_say` call; `p-<ms>` ids instead of `prompt_delta`; reusing `/api/voice`, a VoicePage/uuid route, with a voice-session id for kind≠speech; errors filed by the route, not the fast seat. They are only in plan.md and code comments.

The non-speech branch doesn't check `session` (`Servex/Servex.js` /api/voice). `this.sessions.map` is a plain object (`Sessions.js:439`), so `session: "constructor"` or `"__proto__"` finds an inherited value. `this.sessions.write()` then throws inside an async handler with no try/catch, which is an unhandled rejection in Servex. Check `Object.hasOwn(map, session)` and a `/^v-[\w-]+$/` pattern, and wrap the branch the way the speech branch is wrapped.

The brief's speech path and this route are not the same POST: plan.md rightly found that `/api/voice` is Live-Refine's uuid-keyed VoicePage, while real dictation goes through `say()`. The route now means two different things depending on `kind`. Whoever wires report.js needs that in the readme, not only in the route comment.

The smart seat writes through `item` with `path` = the session folder (`Sessions.js:1137`), but the fast seat writes `s.file` directly. Check that the item tool's folder resolution lands on that same `session.jsonl` and not a `page.jsonl`/`task.jsonl` beside it; the test doesn't cover the item-tool path.
The error line is `{log:{at: now_ms(), msg}}` (ms), but this folder's own `log` lines use ISO `at` (session.jsonl). Pick one, so a reader of `log` lines doesn't have to handle both.

The test (`Servex/agents/PromptLines.test.mjs`) only checks that the pure functions fold correctly; it never runs `voice_say`. That is why findings 1–3 pass 8/8. A small test with a stub `Sessions` that calls `say()` twice and once through the respawn path would catch them.
